desc: Annual Report of the Company, Notice convening 53rd Annual General Meeting for the financial year 2025-26 to be Held on Wednesday, September 23rd, 2026 and Intimation of Cut-off Date for remote E-voting of the Company.
Intimation of dispatch of Annual Report for 53rd Annual General Meeting  for the financial year 2025-26 to be held on Wednesday, September 23rd, 2026 to the Shareholders of the Company.
Newspaper publication regarding Notice of 53rd Annual General Meeting to be held on 23rd September, 2026 and information on E-voting.
